items.title: Prime Bank signs payroll banking deal with Indetechs Software
items.description: Prime Bank PLC recently signed a payroll banking agreement with Indetechs Software Ltd, one of the leading software companies in Bangladesh, to offer comprehensive payroll banking services.

items.title: Citizens Bank opens branch in Khatunganj
items.description: Citizens Bank PLC has opened a new branch in Khatunganj, a major commercial hub in Chattogram, to expand its banking services for local businesses and residents.

items.title: Eastern Bank trains bankers on AML, CFT compliance
items.description: Eastern Bank PLC (EBL), as the lead bank, yesterday organised a daylong training workshop on Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) at Baywatch hotel in Cox’s Bazar.

items.title: NRBC Bank’s earnings per share rose in Jan-Sept
items.description: NRBC Bank PLC’s consolidated earnings per share (EPS) rose to Tk 0.58 in the first nine months of 2026, up from Tk 0.10 in the same period a year earlier.

items.title: Meghna Bank gets approval for Tk 400cr subordinated bond
items.description: Meghna Bank PLC has received regulatory approval to issue a seven-year subordinated bond worth Tk 400 crore (Tk 4 billion) to strengthen its capital base and support business expansion.

items.title: Use LDC deferment to diversify exports, raise productivity
items.description: Bangladesh should use the deferment of its graduation from the least developed country category to raise productivity and diversify exports, president of the American Chamber of Commerce in Bangladesh (AmCham) said on Friday.

items.title: Policy push could raise electrical equipment exports to $4b: experts
items.description: The seminar, titled “Power-up Bangladesh: Through Import Substitution and Growing Exports with Electrical Equipment -- Made in Bangladesh”, was held at Radisson Blu Dhaka Water Garden on the occasion of BMATS’s first annual general meeting.
